content: जालम् .²1 A net, snare. .²2 .³({%a%}) A web, cob-web. .³({%b%}) Any woven texture. .²3 A coat of mail, a helmet made of wire. .²4 An eye-hole, lattice, window; जालान्तरप्रेषितदृष्टिरन्या <ls>R. 7. 9</ls>; धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वलभयः संदिग्धपारावताः <ls>V. 3. 2</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 60</ls>. .²5 A collection, an assemblage, number, mass; गभस्तिजालैः प्रदिशो दिशश्च <ls>Mb. 3. 164. 10</ls>; चिन्तासन्ततितन्तुजालनिबिडस्यूतेव <ls>Māl. 5. 10</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 89</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 56</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 58</ls>. .²6 Magic. .²7 Illusion, deception. .²8 An unblown flower. .²9 The membrane which unites the toes of many water-birds. .²10 A disease of the eyes. .²11 Pride, arrogance. .{@-लः@} The Kadamba tree.
